newsitem.title: USA: Recovery notified of patent complaint.
newsitem.headline: Recovery notified of patent complaint.

text.p: Recovery Engineering Inc said it was notified late Friday of a complaint by Brita, a German company whose U.S. distributor is Clorox Co, of alleged patent infringement on Brita's pitcher products.
The complaint names Recovery Engineering and other water filtration companies as defendants, Recovery said.

"The company was aware of Brita's patent prior to developing its own design and is confident it does not infringe upon Brita's patent. The company plans to defend vigorously its right to market and sell these products," Recovery said.
Recovery makes and markets small-scale drinking water systems sold under the PUR brand name for household, marine and recreational use.

The company also said it introduced a new line of household water filters marketed under the PUR Plus brand. The new products will complement its existing series of products and provide a higher level of contaminant reduction than any similar water filters available, the company said.
